frame.objective: Open one reviewed successor PR for the resource-native session kernel across the current SDK packages.
frame.scope_rule: The user asked for all current SDK packages. Do not defer pi, bash, sandbox, scheduler, or memory merely to shrink work. Expand deterministic proof instead.

assignment: Revise the migration contract and candidate checkpoint in place. Preserve the accepted semantic kernel and the user-required all-SDK scope. Fix every independent finding: replace the non-exported MaybePromise import with a local or public type; give exact resolvable package exports and tsdown entries; define explicit current work/attempt/branch/epoch tags so tool snapshots can be built; define load-and-bind and authority-narrowing APIs for resume, fork, and subagents; show a host root context pre-resolving provider resources before child session contexts; include AG-LIFECYCLE-USE, AG-LIFECYCLE-EFFECT, and AG-LIFECYCLE-JOIN in checkpoint custody; replace non-content evidence refs with governed hashes; audit all workspace consumers and include pkg/framework/pumped/tests/agent.test.ts in the editable/migration boundary; reconcile kept eval helpers with the new TurnResult by retaining skill/tool/subagent inspection fields or intentionally migrating the helpers; update every SDK and provider Lite peer range to the current ^5.0.0 plus SDK ^3.0.0 where applicable; make the Claude lease-manager requirement consistent with the provider matrix; add deterministic conformance requirements for sandbox, scheduler, memory, pi, bash, overlap, cancellation isolation, and streaming; describe AG-MCP as no new MCP/automatic collection/native Claude surface while leaving the existing sdk-mcp package unchanged. The package changeset should include only published packages whose public/runtime contract changes; a test-only pumped consumer migration does not require a release entry. Keep one agent turn loop, inert flows, no legacy runtime, no Lite edits, and no product edits. Write a fresh revision candidate checkpoint with all walls pending independent review, new hashes, and blocked self-gate.

budget_and_stop_rule.stop: Stop when deterministic shape/plain-wording/store checks pass, or hand back an irreconcilable public API conflict.

hand_back_rule: Return exact files, hashes, checks, and unresolved questions. No self-acceptance.
output_schema: Revised contract, revised candidate checkpoint, exact checks, hashes, and raw evidence only.
